facts.fact: UNICEF Comores says e-Msomo, the national education management platform built by the ministry with ANADEN, is in use and holds over 80,000 pupils, 700 schools and 3,000 teachers in one national database.
The post says e-Msomo covers all school levels and tracks each pupil's school path, attendance and evaluations, with schools being added progressively.
e-Msomo was developed by the Ministry of National Education with ANADEN and UNICEF support, according to UNICEF Comores.
UNICEF Comores says e-Msomo covers all school levels, from pre-school to the final year.
The post says e-Msomo lets the ministry follow pupil attendance and evaluations at any time, and parents follow their children in real time.
More than 700 schools are on e-Msomo as at the December 2025 post, with schools integrated progressively.
